draft_evidence.quote:
"Then use it on yourself first. Before anyone." She looked up. "I want to know what you find, and I want to be the one you tell."

He had been asked for a great many things by a great many people about what he was — a demonstration, a transcript, a baseline, a sentence with the hole in the right place — and he stood in a steading's back room and catalogued that nobody had ever attached a condition to it before. Not a price; the Compact priced it. A condition: a thing he would have to do first, and a person he would have to tell, both hers to set, and both right. He had a page on her knee that said what he had chosen for her, and she had read it, and this was her answer, and it was the only one in the log that had ever come back with terms.

"Yes," he said. "First. And you."

comparison_evidence.quote: Oryn's condition: self first; ask first (the book's losable moral stake, Ch16/18/22).

findings.consequence: A full-draft search for an ask-first requirement returns no instance. The scene establishes self-first and tell-Oryn, then narrates those as the complete first condition. This omits the explicit consent rule that later Chapter 16/18/22 checkpoints are meant to test, leaving the book's losable moral stake without its required on-page terms.
findings.repair_target: Establish Oryn's ask-first condition and Cael's acceptance in this scene without changing the fixed lines, adding a theory, or resolving the later moral test.

comparison_evidence.quote:
He did the thing she had asked him to do that night, alone, in the loft, with the five of them asleep round him and the lantern out, because she had said *first* and *before anyone* and he had said *yes*.

He had not tried it in three days; the currents had come up out of the general flow on their own, and he had let them and learned their sounds, and had not once turned the new thing on himself on purpose, because on purpose was the reading, and the reading was hers, and she had set a condition on it. He met it now.

findings.consequence: The log defines the condition as both self-first and telling Oryn the result, but calls it met while Oryn is asleep and before any telling occurs. This makes Cael's ethical ledger inaccurate at the exact moment the chapter relies on that ledger to prove accountability.
findings.repair_target: Keep the completed self-first use distinct from the still-open obligation to tell Oryn, so the log's status matches what has happened on the page.

draft_evidence.quote: He knew three things about it that were not guesses, and he counted them. It had been there before Oryn; session nine was five years old and she was two months. It had been there before Brom's read caught it, because a read catches what is already there. And it was not the Quiet — the Quiet was outside him, a line on the ground that stopped Paths, and this was inside, and the Paths, the fragments, went round it as if they had been built to.

comparison_evidence.quote: Cael's first self-reading, described ONLY as location and sensation (a place at the center that the nine — ten — go around; not a fragment; earlier than any Tide source) — no name, no theory, no 'still place' phrase yet (Ch22 names it), no 'primordial/before/source'.

findings.consequence: The clause 'as if they had been built to' moves beyond perceived location and flow into implied design or purpose. Because the packet explicitly reserves ontology and requires sensation only, a reader can take this as an early claim that the fragments were constructed around the anomaly rather than merely observed to pass around it.
findings.repair_target: Keep the observation to location, movement, and temporal comparison; remove the implication of construction, purpose, maker, or ontology.

This is emotionally effective object-work, but it may underline the absence more strongly than the packet's request that it sit at the table unremarked. Because no character remarks on Hesk or the package aloud, this remains a taste concern rather than a finding.

strengths: Yes: worldbuilding is done through mechanism and use. Thornwater's economy appears as three foods and negotiated marks; Tide healing appears as reserve, route, hands, and patient questions; institutional reach appears as Pike's copied completion line and broker accounting; progression appears as idle-state practice and recovery arithmetic.

There is no fight, exactly as prohibited. The self-reading is nevertheless a memorable set piece with load-bearing physical conditions: the dark loft creates privacy, sleeping companions enforce 'before anyone,' sternum-and-back hand placement reproduces Oryn's method, and the lantern/log turn sensation into accountable record. Its bounded win is writable as: Cael removed the anomaly's ability to remain only an unlocated waiting problem by using the tenth fragment on himself; he did not remove its mystery.

The disclosure gives Oryn genuine authority rather than making her approval a reward. She reads the page, distinguishes knowledge from theory, sets terms, and remains a healer whose professional strategy differs from every member of the established circle.

The three-day integration cost is unusually legible without becoming combat damage: intrusive current perception creates an attention bill, Storm resettles audibly, Wind's ground arrives late, and the idle state is learned as restraint rather than silence.

The birthday builds found family through work rather than declaration: Lira practices one-handed payment, Brom obtains three foods without an audible order, Karis spends her returned voice, Seln reads the institutional consequence, and Oryn remains both at the table and independent through her route accounting.

The fragment inventory is precise and audio-safe. All ten sources reconcile with state, the Pressure line avoids the Feryn/Oryn rhyme, the anomaly remains uncounted, and the mandated final two paragraphs land exactly on the log after Chapter 13's dialogue ending.

Production hygiene is strong: 5,270 words is within tolerance; metadata, summary-substitution, modern-register, feeling/growth, pitch, and chapter-level anti-tic searches are clean; attribution survives the six-speaker scene; names pass the registry ear check; and injuries persist through posture and use.
